result.markdown: --- title: Fantastic sealog and where to find it date: last-modified image: "assets/Antarcturus_on_anthomastus_S0804.jpg" abstract: "" description: "Let the machine handle the boring work, so we can focus on the science." categories: - R - ShinyApps filters: - openlinksinnewpage execute: echo: true eval: false citation: true draft: false --- ![An antarcturid isopod sitting on an anthomastus](assets/Antarcturus_on_anthomastus_S0804.jpg) After I sailed with wonderful RV *Falkor too* early this year with dream team SOI, Ocean Census, and GoSouth, and learned about a fantastic system onboard, I had an idea of further strengthen the sealog system by making a neat interface for scientist to search through it. More than 6 months later I have finally finished it. ## The Sealog System As much as I educated myself (please do correct if I am wrong here!) Sealog is part of the open source plattform from ... It has been deployed on research vessels not only on *Falkor too*, but also ... The main goal of the sealog system is to simplify the logging process onboard during the cruise and operations. *Falkor too* has two seperate sealog systems, one for the ship and one for the ROV *SuBastian* during dives. What the scientists are interested in is apparently the latter, where the MTs, scientists were tirelessly logging occasions, observations, and sampling events during the dive.
